references.text: The fruit of the mouth is a tree of life, but violence feeds the mouth.
For a fool speaks folly, and his heart plans wickedness to practice godlessness and speak error against the Lord.
Guard your heart above all else, for from it flow the springs of life.
The good person brings forth good from the good treasure in their heart, and the evil person brings forth evil, for the mouth speaks from the overflow of the heart.
